[name="？？？"]谁允许你走了？
[dialog]
[charslot]
[playMusic(intro="$awakening_intro",key="$awakening_loop", volume=0.6)]
[CameraShake(duration=1.5, xstrength=15, ystrength=15, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

[Blocker(a=0.5, r=1, g=1, b=1, fadetime=1, block=true)]
[playsound(key="$d_avg_churchfire", loop=true, channel="a",volume=0)]
[SoundVolume(volume=0.7, fadetime=2,channel="a")]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=1, block=true)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1238_1#5$1",duration=1.5)]

[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1237_1#1$1")]
[name="望"]是你……
[CameraShake(duration=0.3, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1238_1#6$1")]
[name="“老天师”"]岁老二！*炎国粗口*，我就知道是你个臭崽子！
[name="“老天师”"]一天到晚不安生，不躲在破庙里下你那破棋，撒泼耍浑闹到我的地盘上来了？
[name="“老天师”"]你们几个人在这闹上一场，糟蹋了多少庄稼！你看我今天不揍你！
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1236_1#4$1")]
[name="绩"]当心！
[dialog]
[charslot]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_firecut", volume=0.6)]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=1, g=1, b=1, fadetime=1, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=1, block=true)]
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1236_1#4$1",duration=0.3)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_jghtket")]
[CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=10, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[delay(time=0.5)]
[charslot(duration=0.5)]
[delay(time=0.5)]
绸缎在炽白的火焰前一触即燃，在转瞬间灰飞烟灭。
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1237_1#1$1")]
[name="望"]……
[dialog]
[playsound(key="$d_avg_spelldfns_1")]
[charslot(duration=0.3)]
[Blocker(a=0.6, r=1, g=1, b=1, fadetime=0.5, block=true)]
[playsound(key="$d_avg_glassbroken")]
[StopSound(channel="a", fadetime=2)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=false)]
[delay(time=2.5)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1238_1#5$1")]
[name="“老天师”"]逆向分解源石技艺？你什么时候学会的……不对……这是“因果”？
[name="“老天师”"]呵……你还剩多少颗子，还能挡我几次火？
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1237_1#1$1")]
[name="望"]天师……现在恐怕也不是动手的时候吧。
[name="望"]天机阁如今损失惨重，你要是再有三长两短，大炎北边的防线可就岌岌可危了。
[name="望"]在炎国北境虎视眈眈的，可不止那些邪魔秽物吧。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1238_1#6$1")]
[name="“老天师”"]少吓唬人！我今天非要教训你！
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1237_1#1$1")]
[name="望"]那和你一道那几位长生者，你也不在乎了？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1238_1#5$1")]
[name="“老天师”"]你……
[charslot(slot = "m", name = "avg_npc_1237_1#1$1")]
[name="望"]呵……你为了心智不受邪魔侵染才装作这一副疯疯癫癫的样子，倒没忘了自己真正该做的事。
[name="望"]权衡利弊，我们未必没有可以合作的可能。
[name="望"]后会有期。
